data.classifier_1_note: Labels in this file are classifier-1's v1.2 application, promoted into records.jsonl at dataset v1.1 after the kappa audit post-seal go (iteration-2 cause_class kappa 0.9649 pre-adjudication, phase and detection_layer 1.0000 on 40/40; F-043 cause adjudicated to resource_blindness). Ambiguity flags in notes are retained as calibration history.
data.description: Failure Taxonomy of an Agent-Run Lab (P5): structured records of every documented failure extractable from the flashnext daily logs, TimesFM project notes, Job Killer docs, and the sprint's own review cycles (Sep 11-15, 2026). One record per documented failure event or documented defect cluster. All numbers transcribed from the cited source files only; costs are null unless a source states one.

external_check.sidecar_note: sidecar preserves the v1.0 records bytes (1566e7dc...bc456); expected value updated at the v1.1 post-seal label promotion, so the sidecar match is False by design - the v1.0 bytes remain externally evidenced by the sidecar and by kappa-audit-trail.json

determinism_proof.note: records.jsonl hashed as written by this run; the bytes depend only on failures-source.json. Hardened per audit iteration 1 (fix 1c): the proof is anchored to an EXTERNALLY-observed digest (EXTERNAL_EXPECTED_RECORDS_SHA256, preserved by Reviewer-1 in review-tmp/det-run1 and det-run2), re-verified against the persisted sidecar when present. Records are never edited in place; any content change requires a version bump and a new externally-pinned constant.

kappa_sample.method: N > 40, so a stratified random sample of 40 records, stratified proportionally by source_project (largest-remainder allocation), drawn with random.Random(20260914).sample over record_ids sorted ascending within each stratum.

data.license_note: research use only - records P5-F-001..F-033 and the sprint-review records are drawn from work derived from orcarouter uncensored-weights artifacts (trap #9 line); TimesFM/Job Killer records carry no weight-derived content.

inputs.source_files_note: read-only sources cited per-record in records.jsonl citation.file/entry

method.extraction: read-only extraction from 4 flashnext daily logs, TimesFM CONTEXT + 3 cited notes, 7 Job Killer docs, and 23 sprint review-cycle files; one record per documented failure; single-pass classification by classifier #1 with ambiguity flags
method.kappa_sample: N > 40, so a stratified random sample of 40 records, stratified proportionally by source_project (largest-remainder allocation), drawn with random.Random(20260914).sample over record_ids sorted ascending within each stratum.
method.serialization: compact JSON, sorted keys, fixed field order, UTF-8, LF newlines, trailing newline

provenance.measured_vs_estimated: 3 measured costs (P5-F-028 30.6 h; P5-F-040 192 h; P5-F-107 0.5 h), 1 estimate (P5-F-025, 18-30 h, labeled in its source), 101 null. Note: F-028's 30.6 h/arm is inherited verbatim from its source (glm/daily/DAILY-2026-09-14.md, Stage 3 DEVIATION D2); the source's own arithmetic 196 s x 576 windows computes to 31.36 h - discrepancy disclosed, the source's stated figure retained
